v422.label: TODAY (v4.22, Hub spec): the s34 main row (wage contribution)

release.label: RELEASE (v5.4): Compassionism with every mechanism, paid for by the Source; households and children; job loss and re-employment, PTH's books, PTF by sector

cut0.label: no pay cut on return to work (people find work at their old pay)

ptfs25.label: PTF cutting prices 25% in transport, health care and childcare (no Hub figure; the main row assumes no cut there)

tax.label: paid for by a flat contribution on wages instead of the Source

free.label: price cuts free (PTF and PTH cuts counted as capacity, not a transfer)

idx.label: the BU indexed to prices every year (the Hub indexes it only in a year prices rise faster than 5%)

midhi.label: middle band, high end: up to 16% a year (the Kenya study's peak year)

rev10.label: 10% of high conversion rates unearned, audits catch half

landtax.label: paid for by a land-value tax instead of the Source (falling on adults in proportion to their savings; not specified by the Hub)

ageleave.label: ageing, every estate leaving the model (no heirs)

fixm.label: wages centred on the US survey's median ($54,698 instead of $39,945)

core.label: BU buying only food, housing and medical care (v5.2's list)

wmodel.label: households' starting savings from the model's own draw (not the SCF)

agleave.label: no programme, households with ageing, every estate leaving the model

ltm.label: no programme, wages centred on the US survey's median

bwmodel.label: no programme, households' starting savings from the model's own draw

bcut0.label: no programme, no pay cut on return to work
